outcome: Methylation rates of FTO gene promoter CpG sites
cohort: 75 neonates and their mothers recruited from Yuying Children's Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University, China.
finding: Higher placental FTO gene expression and lower methylation rates at specific CpG sites in the FTO gene promoter were independently associated with increased birth weight in Chinese neonates.
mod_finding: FTO mRNA expression was negatively associated with CpG6.7.8.9 methylation in mothers who underwent C-section.
